rationale: Despite an initial gap up on 7x relative volume, price has broken down below both session VWAP ($47.25) and the 5-minute 9-EMA ($47.36) on accelerating 1-minute selling volume. In a severely weak macro tape (SPY -3.02%, VIXY +18.03%), this failure to hold VWAP signals exhaustion from early buyers and sets up a mean-reversion move toward the $46.10 intraday support zone, with invalidation placed cleanly above the recent 1-minute lower highs ($47.34) and 9-EMA.
